title: 棒球明星转型体育**，MLB劳资博弈引关注
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I used to say baseball is a game of failure, but I flipped it and it's more of a game of perseverance because it's the only sport you can play and fail 70% of the time and still
segments.zh: 我曾说棒球是失败的游戏，但我改变了看法，它更像是坚持的游戏，因为这是唯一一项你失败70%仍能被视为成功的运动。

segments.en: Welcome back to the DLM Jason Kelly alongside Alex Rodriguez, buckle up folks.
segments.zh: 欢迎回到DLM，我是Jason Kelly，旁边是Alex Rodriguez，大家系好安全带。

segments.en: This is going to be a good one. We have been so excited to catch up with Ryan Howard, of course, former Philadelphia Philly World Series champion, National League, most valuable player.
segments.zh: 这将是一场精彩的对话。我们非常兴奋能邀请到Ryan Howard，前费城人队世界大赛冠军，国联最有价值球员。

segments.en: He has some things in common with our beloved A-Rod here.
segments.zh: 他和我们亲爱的A-Rod有一些共同点。

segments.en: Nose baseball better than anyone and I can't wait for you guys to chop it up on that.
segments.zh: 他对棒球的理解无人能及，我迫不及待想听你们聊聊这个话题。

segments.en: Also, so much interesting stuff going on in your business life, Ryan and you're joining us from the ATL so even better, great to have you.
segments.zh: 此外，Ryan，你的商业生涯中有很多有趣的事情，而且你从亚特兰大加入我们，更棒了，很高兴你来做客。

segments.en: Hey, thank you guys so much for having me. I appreciate it.
segments.zh: 嘿，非常感谢你们的邀请，我很感激。

segments.en: All right, Alex, I'm going to start by asking you, I'm going to do this a little bit different now.
segments.zh: 好的，Alex，我打算先问你，这次我想换个方式。

segments.en: You tell me because we've talked a little bit offline, tell me about Ryan.
segments.zh: 你告诉我，因为我们私下聊过一些，跟我讲讲Ryan。

segments.en: Tell me about Ryan in front of him. Yeah, so Ryan is a few years younger than me, as you can tell by his skin and it's much better than mine, smooth operator.
segments.zh: 说说你面前的瑞安。是的，瑞安比我小几岁，从他的皮肤就能看出来，比我好多了，真是个光滑的家伙。

segments.en: Now Ryan is one of these guys that, you know, even when you play against him, you can't help but like love him and respect him.
segments.zh: 瑞安是那种即使你和他对阵，也会忍不住喜欢和尊敬他的人。

segments.en: He did everything the right way. He was always very respectful in the World Series.
segments.zh: 他做事总是很得体，在世界大赛中总是非常尊重对手。
